content.name: Henrik Paulsen
content.title: Director of Product
content.summary: Director of product with 15 years in digital media, online travel, e-commerce and logistics software, holding a Diplom in Business Informatics. Lead four product teams at a Hamburg freight platform whose shipper app grew booked volume by 34% in two years. Experienced in building product organisations, setting strategy with founders and working with works councils on internal tools.

experience.title: Director of Product
bullets: Lead 5 product managers and 3 designers across shipper, carrier and pricing products, setting annual strategy with the founders.
Grew booked freight volume through the shipper app by 34% in two years by launching instant quotes and self-serve customs documents.
Built a product operations function with shared metrics, quarterly business reviews and a single roadmap for 60 engineers.
Managed a €1.2m annual budget for research, tooling and external design partners.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
bullets: Owned checkout and payments for an online fashion marketplace in five EU markets.
Introduced buy-now-pay-later and local payment methods, lifting checkout conversion by 7% in Austria and the Netherlands.
Led a team of two PMs through the PSD2 strong customer authentication changes with minimal conversion loss.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Managed search and filters for a package holiday booking site with around 3 million monthly visitors.
Ran more than 80 experiments on search results; the best performers raised booking rate by 12%.
Worked with the data team on a hotel ranking model that combined price, reviews and margin.

experience.title: Junior Product Manager
bullets: Coordinated the relaunch of a regional news website and its first mobile app.
Defined the paywall test plan that converted 9,000 readers to digital subscriptions in year one.
Wrote specifications and acceptance tests for an external development agency.

courses.name: Professional Scrum Product Owner II (PSPO II)

achievements.title: Conference talk

achievements.detail: Mentor for founders at a Hamburg start-up accelerator since 2021.
